zh: 用过哪些借贷人一旦确定，之后还能用的人也就确定了；而剩余现金当天花掉，过去的历史只通过“最后一笔要还多少”影响下一天。最后一笔欠得越少，下一步的选择就越宽。
对每个已用集合 mask，只记录能达到的最小末笔欠款。转移时枚举 mask 中最后借的那个人 j：只要“去掉 j 的集合”的最小欠款不超过 lender[j]，j 就能接在最后，末笔欠款变成 payback[j]。所有可达集合中元素最多的那个，其元素个数就是答案。
空集欠款为 0；按 mask 从小到大递推（去掉一位得到的子集数值更小，已经算好）；为节省内存，把不同的 payback 值排序后压缩成 1..r 的秩，用 2^n 个字节存状态，不可达记为 r+1，并预先算出每个 lender[j] 能覆盖的最大秩，比较时只比秩；递推中对每个可达的 mask 用其元素个数更新答案。
en: Once the set of used lenders is fixed, so is the set still available; and since leftover cash is spent the same day, the past affects the next day only through how much the last loan owes. The smaller that debt, the more choices remain.

For each used set mask, record only the smallest final debt that can be reached. To compute it, try every j in mask as the last lender: if the smallest debt of mask without j is at most lender[j], j can go last and the final debt becomes payback[j]. The size of the largest reachable set is the answer.

The empty set owes 0; process masks in increasing order, since removing a bit gives a smaller mask that is already computed; to save memory, sort the distinct payback values and compress them to ranks 1..r, store the states in 2^n bytes with r+1 meaning unreachable, and precompute for each lender[j] the largest rank it can cover so comparisons use ranks only; update the answer with the size of every reachable mask.

explanationEn:
## Approach

For each set mask of used lenders, record the smallest final payback that can be reached. The empty set owes 0. Enumerate the last chosen lender j: as long as the minimum debt of mask without j does not exceed lender[j], j can be placed last, and the candidate final debt is payback[j]. The largest number of elements among all reachable sets is the answer. Sort the distinct payback values and compress them to 1..r, using 0 for the empty set and r+1 for unreachable; store the states in a bytearray, which takes only 2^n bytes.

## Proof of correctness

After the same set has been used, the set of lenders still available afterwards is exactly the same, and leftover cash is spent that day, so the past affects the next day only through the final debt. A smaller final debt can perform any next step that a larger one can, so keeping only the minimum never loses an optimal continuation. For a non-empty mask, every valid order has some last lender j whose prefix belongs to mask without j and owes at most lender[j]; conversely, if the minimum reachable debt of that subset satisfies the condition, a corresponding prefix exists that j can follow. So enumerating the last element decides reachability and the minimum final debt without omissions or duplicates. Removing one bit from a subset gives a smaller integer, so processing masks in order has already computed every dependency. Taking the largest size over all reachable masks gives the optimal number of borrowing days; the last loan counts without needing a later loan to repay it. Rank compression preserves all order relations: limits[j] is the number of distinct payback values not exceeding lender[j], and the unreachable rank is always greater than that threshold.

## Complexity

Time O(n·2^n+n log n), space O(2^n+n). For n=20 this enumerates exactly 20·2^19=10,485,760 last-element candidates, and the DP array is 1,048,576 bytes; no dimension is indexed by amount, and payback≥lender is not required.
